boundedGaps.angle: Onboard sensor capabilities and limits are a separate feasibility/design constraint, alongside goal, speed/kinematics and current/future collision risk.
boundedGaps.whyMissing: Q002 selects motion constraints, Q003 rejects universal optimality, and neither requires identifying sensor limits as the independent remaining constraint.
boundedGaps.repairTarget: Extend an existing objectives item rather than add another generic role-recall question.

boundedGaps.angle: Differentiate the goal term a, current-heading term b and previous-command term c, including higher c giving smoother but less reactive control.
boundedGaps.whyMissing: Q045 directly tests only the previous term, Q047 supplies all errors, Q049 tests previous-command preference but not the stated reactivity trade-off.
boundedGaps.repairTarget: Extend Q045 or Q049 into a parallel association or controlled trade-off; retain the wrapped-angle and cost tasks as separate operations.

boundedGaps.angle: The table’s actual low-versus-moderate computation association and simple-prototype-versus-noisy-real-robot typical-use association.
boundedGaps.whyMissing: Q057 only asks whether labels are qualitative and Q058 only asks completeness; neither requires mapping the omitted rows to Bug and VFH.
boundedGaps.repairTarget: Extend the table item with the named rows and explicit qualitative scope, without implying all real robots must use VFH.

boundedGaps.angle: Interpret the plotted red current configuration relative to the shaded forbidden region and the two joint-angle axes.
boundedGaps.whyMissing: Q063 defines the region but never asks whether the actual displayed point is inside it; Q064 instead corrects the mapping arrow.
boundedGaps.repairTarget: Extend Q063 to the displayed point being outside the shown C-obstacle. Avoid inventing precise coordinates from the stylized/nonuniform tick drawing or claiming global path feasibility.

duplicationAccounting: 86 author concept IDs are not 86 independent concepts. Q069/Q070 are symbolic and numerical angles of the same attractive model; Q074/Q075 are count and growth angles of one grid-scaling concept.
DistBug, TangentBug and I-Bug are name-only examples on p1140. No unsupported algorithm-detail gap is invented.
The p1157 force-arrow colors illustrate already represented attraction, repulsion and net-force concepts; no redundant color-trivia draft is required.
The p1153 mask figure’s newly blocked direction is substantively tested by Q052, so it is not claimed as another missing concept.
Q086 now tests the actual three weights and smoothing/reactivity trade-off rather than repeating local/global roles.
Question-level angles and repeated source pages are not counted as independent concepts; the32-family prior taxonomy remains the bounded ledger.

additionalBoundedGaps.target: One integrated VFH decision from a circular density vector, explicit threshold equality and feasibility mask, through valley/candidate identification and wrapped weighted-cost minimization.
additionalBoundedGaps.whyMissing: Existing Q036,Q040,Q041,Q046,Q047 isolate threshold, valley count, center, wrap and a precomputed-error cost. No item executes the complete source reduction/selection chain.
additionalBoundedGaps.remedy: Use mutually consistent common reference headings and candidates. State how candidates are generated and ties handled; do not import an unprinted cell-weight formula as if supplied by the slides.

additionalBoundedGaps.target: One multi-step comparison of Bug1 and Bug2 departure/travel decisions on the same fully specified boundary event sequence.
additionalBoundedGaps.whyMissing: Existing items recognize individual rules, compare two goal distances or one valid crossing; none combines full survey/shorter return versus earliest eligible fixed-line crossing and computes the different travel outcome.
additionalBoundedGaps.remedy: Provide finite boundary positions/arclengths, goal distances, original-line membership and free outgoing directions; derive both outcomes without an unconditional efficiency claim. A strengthened existing item can close the angle without adding paraphrase volume.
